evals.prompt: Write a blog post from this talk: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IVee1JXbrQE
evals.expected_output: A concise, code-first Jekyll post covering a selection of the least-known C++23 features from Josuttis' 90-minute ACCU talk, each shown with a compiled, runnable example and a summary.
assertions: A post .md file was produced
Front matter matches blog conventions and permalink matches file name
Title uses 'C++ - ' prefix and names speaker/conference in parentheses
Body opens with the YouTube link line
Post is concise (60-300 body lines)
Code-first: at least 3 code blocks and >=35% of body lines are code
Limited quoting (<=3 blockquote lines)
Ends with a Summary section
>=60% of non-header C++ listings are complete programs (have main)
All complete C++ programs in the post compile (Apple clang or Homebrew LLVM clang, c++23/c++2c)
Links the talk's slide deck near the top
